# 括号展开

Component ID: shotcraft-brace-expand

## Purpose and selection

- 用括号打开一个短概念的范围或章节主题。

Do not use:

- 不是集合运算或关系图；不能用括号动画证明包含关系、解释公式或模拟界面展开。
- 不要把文字特效当作全场景内容；避免与运镜或另一强调动作同时争抢焦点。

## Supported inputs

- title: 一个短概念，单行最多6字；括号用于主题框定，不插入空格模拟逐词字幕。

Text limits:

~~~json
{
  "title": {
    "maxLines": 1,
    "maxLineLength": 6
  }
}
~~~

Editable variable contract (demo defaults are not user content; apply both variable limits and the stricter recipe text/capacity limits above):

~~~json
[
  {
    "id": "title",
    "label": "title",
    "update": "reload",
    "type": "string",
    "default": "理解机制",
    "maxLength": 6
  },
  {
    "id": "motionCueTimes",
    "label": "Measured phase cue times",
    "update": "reload",
    "type": "string",
    "default": "{}",
    "maxLength": 2048
  }
]
~~~

## Reading order and motion

- 建立概念边界
- 括号展开并露出标题
- 保持标题与括号稳定可读

Pattern: kinetic-type. Native default duration: 3.857s. Minimum final readable hold: 0.7s.

- Target: .sc-content *
- Visible action: 括号张开揭示短标题

- Narration cue: 绑定实测旁白中与“括号张开揭示短标题”对应的精确短语；保持该段原曲线。

## Known failure modes and recovery

- overflow: 拆分语义或选择其他配方，不缩小文字或截断。
- missingInput: 要求真实内容，不使用英文演示文案或虚构界面。
- timingMismatch: 重新绑定实测短语；内部动作比例不变，超长旁白拆镜。
- inapplicable: 选择合适配方；仅配方模式下报告库缺口，不临时绘制替代图形。

Under recipes-only policy, missing capability means another validated recipe, a meaningful split or an explicit gap; not custom graphics disguised as reuse.
